explore-length.title: Too much cable
explore-length.prompt: Cut the cable to the length you actually need.
explore-length.success: Less cable, less loss. Coiling the spare length would have kept all of its loss.

explore-freq.title: Up in frequency
explore-freq.prompt: Step the frequency up to 440 MHz and watch the loss.
explore-freq.success: The same cable loses about a tenth as much on 80 m as it does on 70 cm.

explore-uhf.title: Rescue the 70 cm station
explore-uhf.prompt: Choose a cable that gets at least half the power to the antenna.
explore-uhf.success: Low-loss foam coax gets more than half your power there. RG-58 wasted 90% of it.
